d: Manage multiple IT projects aligned with business goals through clear scope definition, structured planning, proactive risk management and effective stakeholder coordination. Deliver projects within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
4–6 years of project management experience, focused on IT projects, particularly AI, advanced technology or software development.
At least 1–2 years of experience managing multiple projects simultaneously within the overall experience requirement.
Certification such as PMP, PMI-ACP or equivalent.
Strong skills in project planning, budgeting, resource coordination, risk management and stakeholder communication.
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.
Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage vendor performance.
r: li
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and acceptance criteria in alignment with business requirements.
li
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules and resource allocations to support efficient delivery.
li
Establish stakeholder communication plans and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
li
Identify and manage project risks, issues and dependencies, implementing mitigation plans and corrective actions.
li
Lead cross-functional teams and coordinate internal departments, vendors and external partners to achieve project milestones.
li
Monitor progress using project management tools and track performance against agreed scope, schedule, budget and quality requirements.
li
Manage project budgets, expenditure and scope changes to control costs and prevent overruns.
li
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry best practices and internal policies.
li
Act as the primary liaison between internal teams, clients and vendors to coordinate delivery and resolve issues.
li
Conduct project status meetings and provide stakeholders and senior management with progress reports, risks and recommended actions.
li
Coordinate with business and technical teams to ensure project deliverables meet agreed requirements.
li
Oversee quality assurance activities and validate deliverables against acceptance criteria.
li
Manage vendor relationships and monitor compliance with contractual commitments and service-level agreements.
li
Conduct post-project reviews, document lessons learned and recommend improvements to project delivery processes.

d: The iconic Rixos Gulf Hotel Doha offers a distinctive luxury lifestyle, combining warm Rixos hospitality with exceptional service, world-class amenities, vibrant entertainment, and innovative all-inclusive Food & Beverage concepts. With 378 beautifully appointed guest rooms, premium bedding, and an elegant atmosphere, the hotel delivers an unforgettable experience for every guest.
We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Executive to join our vibrant team.
Under the general guidance and supervision of the Director of Sales implements all sales activities and maximizes business opportunities in his / her specific area of responsibility.
Strong knowledge of event planning, banquet operations, conference management, and guest service standards.
Proven ability to handle enquiries, prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and coordinate events from planning to execution.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong client relationships.
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with attention to detail and the ability to work under pressure.
Commercially minded with the ability to identify sales opportunities and achieve revenue targets.
To drive, manage and maintain robust positive relations with all key accounts and business partners and the hotel.

To work as a team member to create the most professional sales team in the hotel. To meet and exceed sales targets set in the monthly and yearly forecasts and to direct all efforts to maximizing the hotel’s revenues and profits in across all revenue streams specifically rooms, small meeting conference and food & beverage departments.
To develop network of contacts to encourage and secure hotel trial of key decision makers.
Generates and maintains customers of corporate segment through various sales activities (face to face sales calls, telephone calls, entertainment).
Maintains a high level of exposure for the hotel through direct sales, telephone and written communications.
To promote efficiency, confidence, courtesy and an extremely high standard of social skills.
To demonstrate pride in the workplace and personal appearance at all times when representing the hotel thus identifying a high level of commitment
Maintains the highest standards of professionalism, ethics and attitude towards all hotel guests, clients, staff and employees.
To adhere to Company and Hotel rules and regulations at all times.
Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum 2-4 years of experience in Meetings & Events, Sales, Banquet Operations, or Event Management within the hospitality industry.
Previous experience in Middle East is preferred.
Experience with hotel PMS, sales and catering systems (Opera Cloud, Anis, Cvent, Passk, or similar platforms).
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required by business demands.
Fluency in English is essential; additional language skills are an advantage.
Ability to lead event planning meetings and coordinate with multiple departments.
Problem-solving skills with the ability to make quick decisions during event operations.
Team player with a proactive and results-driven attitude.
Excellent time management and follow-up skills.
